title: Resort/Theme Park
content: So more and more I've been dreaming about this other hotel...definitely not the same as the hotel/casino. The room set up seems to be much more like a hostel or a dorm...lots of people staying in one room and lots of shared spaces in general. There's people I'm staying with that in the dreams I definitely know, but when I wake up I don't think most of them are people I actually do. Outside the windows I can see this very large amusement park, there's part of a log flume type water ride where the river part of it goes right by the windows. I also just know, without actually seeing it, that just beyond this amusement park is a beach. I'm thinking this may be behind the boardwalk I often dream of. Weird thing is though, even though even though I can see this and people are on the various rides, I have this distinct impression that it's somewhere I'm not supposed to go. To look at by never enter. Not just that, but this feeling that I CAN'T enter, like some other bubble of reality. It's hard to describe the feeling really. Nobody else seems to even give this amusement park any mind, like it's purely background. Semi related, recently I was dreaming about riding one of the trains that originate from the weird subway station. I've never before been able to get off the train where it was going but this time the train derailed and kind of crashed on it's side, and so everyone had to get off. I took the opportunity to wander through a kind of wooded area until I came across another what looked like either a theme park or other kind of tourist type area, only much larger then life. Again I can't entirely describe the feeling, other then just feeling "more than". Someone caught me though and was like "oh no no, this isn't ready yet" and escorted me back towards where the train sat still derailed. I was put into some sort of a truck along with the other passengers to make sure we didn't wander off and be taken back but it was right then that I woke up.
